question: With which neighbouring country did India sign the Farakka Treaty in 1996 for sharing of the Ganga Waters and on augmenting its flows?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Farakka Treaty:-**

 
 
• **The Farakka Agreement, also known as the Ganga Water Treaty, was signed on November 12, 1996, between India and Bangladesh to share the waters of the Ganges River.**
 
• The agreement was a significant breakthrough in bilateral relations between the two countries, as it resolved a long-standing dispute over the sharing of water resources.
 
• **The agreement establishes a 30-year water-sharing arrangement that divides the Ganges waters between India and Bangladesh based on the time of year and the flow of the river. **
 
• The agreement also includes provisions for the construction of joint projects to augment the flow of the Ganges and improve water management in the region.
 
• The Farakka Agreement has been hailed as a success story in international water diplomacy.
 
• It has helped to improve relations between India and Bangladesh and has provided a framework for the sustainable management of shared water resources.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhutan:-**

 
 
• **It is a small kingdom located in the eastern Himalayas, bordered by India to the south and China to the north. **
 
• It is a landlocked country, with no direct access to the sea. Bhutan is known for its stunning mountain scenery, its rich Buddhist culture, and its commitment to environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• **Nepal:-**
 
 
• **It is a country located in the southern Himalayas, bordered by India to the south and China to the north. **
 
• It is a landlocked country, with no direct access to the sea.
 
• Nepal is known for its stunning mountain scenery, including Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in the world. Nepal is also a popular destination for trekking and mountaineering.
 
 
 
• **Afghanistan**:-
 
 
• **It is a landlocked country located in Central Asia, bordered by Pakistan to the east and south, Iran to the west, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan to the north. **
 
• Afghanistan is a mountainous country, with the Hindu Kush mountains running through the center of the country.
 
• Afghanistan is known for its rich history, its diverse culture, and its strategic location. 
 
• India share 106 border with Afghanistan.
